title: AI Avatar v28 (Security Support, Voxel Avatar)🛡️
why_read: A quirky personal project combining a virtual avatar companion with a basic self-made security checklist feature, interesting mainly as a novelty rather than a serious security tool.
analysis: AI Avatar is a hobby application that displays an animated VRM avatar in your editor or browser that reacts to AI coding assistants, and this update adds a lightweight 'security' feature including library vulnerability checks and security news. The author explicitly states they are not a security expert and built the feature mainly to learn, which limits its value as a trustworthy security tool for professional use. It's a fun side project blending UI personality with coding tools, but it isn't a serious contribution to application security practice. The appeal is mostly novelty and personal-project storytelling rather than technical substance.
